title: WHIM
tagline: A cross-platform .NET 9 product built on a clean-architecture backend
summary: A multi-project .NET 9 solution pairing a layered backend with mobile clients. The codebase is deliberately partitioned — domain, application, infrastructure, and contracts are separate projects — so business rules stay independent of storage, transport, and platform concerns.
highlights: Clean-architecture layering enforced at the project level, so dependencies point inward rather than by convention alone.
Containerised from the start, with separate compose definitions for local, staging, and production.
Ships an admin surface and a dedicated media-processing service alongside the main API.
methodology: Split the solution into Domain, Application, Infrastructure, and Contracts projects so the core has no dependency on EF Core, HTTP, or the mobile clients.
Backed persistence with PostgreSQL through EF Core migrations, with connection settings supplied per environment.
Ran the stack under Docker Compose with distinct local, staging, and production overrides, fronted by nginx.
Built mobile clients against a shared Contracts project so DTOs cannot drift between backend and app.
Handled identity with JWT and OAuth integrations, and instrumented the services with Serilog.
Scripted the local setup so a fresh clone generates its own environment file with safe local defaults instead of shared secrets.
